claim: Patchline ships generated fixture minimizers for every supported ecosystem. Each minimizer uses the real analyzer as an oracle and applies delta-debugging to reduce a seed input to the smallest fixture that still reproduces a destructive data-change finding, then proves the result is 1-minimal (removing any remaining line drops the target finding). This is proven against a real Cassandra migration fetched from the laaksomavrick/twitter-go repository, which is reduced from its full size to a minimal reproducing fixture, alongside minimizers for SQL migrations, Spark pipeline overwrites, and Avro schema-compatibility breaks.
